text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 tail latency spike detected for router-service in us-west-2. SLO breach (p95/p99) observed for the last 6m. Streaming sessions reporting stalls; error rate (504/429) up 3.1%. Auto-escalation to #incidents. :rotating_light:

ash: I'm on it — taking the bridge. Initial hypothesis: routing policy change 12m ago + weight jittering on LB shards.

laura: Confirming dashboards — p95 jumped from 120ms -> 420ms, p99 from 300ms -> 2.8s. Streaming stalls coincident with routing churn spikes on shards 7/9.

samir: I see increased redis miss rates on prefix cache around the same time. Could be hot partitioning after a routing reshuffle.

miguel: Traffic heatmap shows a region-skew: us-west-2 receiving ~14% more fanout than usual, some nodes overloaded.

ash: Are any customer-facing errors showing for major tenants? laura: Yes — 3 enterprise customers have alerts for repeated 504s on streaming endpoints. No PII exposure.

ash: Quick plan: 1) Pause recent routing policy rollout (if still active). 2) Pin traffic away from overloaded shards. 3) Clear prefix cache for affected keys. 4) If needed, revert LB weight changes.

samir: Running a dry command to pause policy rollout: ```
# infractl rollout pause --service router-service --policy route-weight-v2
# check status:
infractl rollout status router-service --policy route-weight-v2
```

ops-bot: rollout route-weight-v2 paused by samir @4999001251.

laura: After pause: small drop in p95 (~350ms) but p99 still high. Tail is sticky.

miguel: I'm going to shift 30% of traffic off hot shard set to a fallback pool. Command: ```
# routerctl shift-weight --from-shards s7,s8 --to-pool fallback-usw2 --percent 30
```

ash: Ash here — be mindful of cache warm-up, shifting might transiently increase misses. Coordinate with samir to pre-warm.

samir: Pre-warming prefix cache for keys with top-1000 hot routes: ```
# cachectl warm --service router-service --keys-file /tmp/hotkeys.txt
```

laura: Observed customer impact timeline pinned to 23:12-23:20 UTC. We're now at 23:31 UTC, mitigation in progress. Notifying CS to page affected customers.

kate: Taking second on-call. Can you summarize current mitigation and the ask?

ash: Summary for handoff -> we paused the policy rollout, shifted 30% traffic from s7/s8 to fallback-usw2, pre-warmed cache. Need someone to monitor p95/p99 + streaming stall rate for 30m and ready to roll back the shift if errors increase. Also validate that the fallback pool meets latency SLOs.

kate: Got it. I'll watch dashboards and run canary checks. Adding a lightweight canary probe hitting streaming route with 10s cadence. If probe fails >3 in a row, to page SRE lead.

sre-lead: I want a root-cause hypothesis thread itemized: route propagation lag + weight jitter -> hot partition -> cache misses -> increased tail latency and streaming stalls. Action items: rollback policy (done), traffic shift (in progress), cache warm (in progress), full shard drain if no improvement.

miguel: Canary results after shift: basic RPC latencies look fine on fallback, but streaming stall delta only improved by ~18%. p99 still ~1.6s.

ash: Since partial mitigation didn't fully resolve, let's prepare a staged failover for s7: drain new streams and stop accepting new sessions. Command: ```
# routerctl set-accepting s7 false
# routerctl drain s7 --allow-active 60
```

laura: Noting customer impact: CS already emailed two customers; one asked for an incident timeline. Please collect the short RCA points.

ops-bot: ticket #INC-2026 created for enterprise customer follow-ups by CS.

samir: Executed drain on s7. Monitoring connection counts. Active sessions dropping as expected.

miguel: After s7 drain, p99 dropped to ~780ms, streaming stalls down 60% from peak. Looks like s7 was the main hot partition.

kate: Continuing monitoring for 45m. I'll update post-mortem template with timeline. Assigning owners: RCA lead -> laura, mitigation writeup -> samir, customer comms -> CS (ops-bot).

ash: If p99 stabilizes under 500ms and streaming stalls <5% of peak for 30m, we'll close live mitigation. Otherwise escalate to infra team for permanent routing fix.

laura: Note for RCA: include the config change that introduced non-deterministic weight updates in rollout controller (suspect race between propagation and seed rebalancer).

sre-lead: Also capture telemetry gap: route-propagation lag not well-covered in alerts. Add an alert for weight-change-convergence > 30s.

ash: Final immediate actions logged: pause rollout (samir), shift traffic (miguel), cache warm (samir), drain shard s7 (samir), CS notified (ops-bot). Next steps: full RCA within 48h, quantify cost of failover, and schedule policy rollout bugfix and test harness.

kate: I'm making a short incident post in #postmortems once the RCA PR is ready. Leaving the bridge to ash (oncall) for final sign-off.

ash: Thanks team — handing back to oncall rotation. If anyone sees regression, @kate or @sre-lead, please re-open. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation partially successful, status: MONITORING. Will auto-close bridge if no regressions in 60m.
